title: Reslicing beyond the current length loses tracked byte provenance
claim: ByteWindow uses bytesAlias, which rejects outputs extending beyond len(input) even when they are valid slices within cap(input) and the existing managed root. After a tracked root is shortened to root[:3:7], both short[1:6] and short[1:6:7] lose all exact taint ranges, and a supported byte-to-string conversion remains untainted. This occurs without mutation or saturation and reproduces with direct wrappers on Go 1.26.6 and Go 1.27.0 and compiler-woven public API calls on Go 1.26.6.
